description: Enhanced: Copy request headers with nested source/target keys (copy-source joins source bucket and key with a slash, REPLACE default), and an explicit content type override carried into the copy headers. Disjoint from native cases.

cases.expected_output:
content-type=application/octet-stream
x-amz-acl=private
x-amz-copy-source=src/a/b.txt
x-amz-metadata-directive=REPLACE
target_key=c/d.txt
result_key=c/d.txt

content-type=image/png
x-amz-acl=private
x-amz-copy-source=images/Lena.png
x-amz-metadata-directive=REPLACE
target_key=Copy.png
result_key=Copy.png
